evidence.positive: Seeded demo-demo patient OR3242-fake-e30c7bfc-1f55-470d-9840-61d751205e7a with case 23102 via the admin API. Drove the shipped build (bundle static/index.LCIyAXid.js) with Playwright as admin: logged in, landed on Home at / with no client_id, opened the demo-demo row menu, clicked Patients (in-app link, URL became /admin/patients?client_id=demo-demo), searched the pmrn and clicked View. Observed on the patient page: Patients trail link href=/admin/patients?client_id=demo-demo; case row Launch href=/app-launch?patient_id=...&case_id=23102&client_id=demo-demo; View Operation href=/admin/patients/<uuid>/operations/<opId>/debugger?client_id=demo-demo; every /api/admin/patients* and /api/procedure-types request from the page carried X-Tenant-Id=demo-demo. Clicked View Operation: debugger meta read 'Case 23102', 'Unable to load case' count 0. Operation tab > Launch link copied http://localhost:52629/api/launch-by-operation/<opId>?client_id=demo-demo. Followed the Launch href: the case rendered (patient banner 'Patient, Test Male, 45 y.o.' with guidance), zero failed /api calls. Also submitted Add Operation from the same Home-entered page: POST /api/admin/patients/<uuid>/operations/create carried X-Tenant-Id=demo-demo, returned 200 with caseId 09622, and the new row's links carried client_id=demo-demo. Backend: POST /api/login/check with no tenant while signed in (admin and loopuser) returned 200 {"needsLogin":false}; signed out with no tenant returned 400 'No login method configured for tenant: null' and set no SESSION cookie; signed out with X-Tenant-Id demo-demo still returned the SSO redirect and set SESSION.
evidence.negative: On the shipped build no link, header or copied URL carried client_id=null (checked trail, Launch, View Operation, copied launch link, every X-Tenant-Id header, and the links of the case created from the page). The debugger reached from Home showed no 'Unable to load case' error. The container log over the positive and post-restore windows contained zero 'relation "operations" does not exist' lines and zero NullPointerException / TenantKey.getOrg lines (grep count 0). The login check never returned 500 in any of the six tenant/session combinations probed, and the tenant-less signed-out case opened no session (no Set-Cookie SESSION on the 400).
evidence.red_check: Two flips, both pre-fix code swapped into the running container and both reverted. (1) Compiled the parent commit's LoginController (52ff41c50^, @Slf4j dropped, javac against the container's /app/libs + /app/classes) and docker-cp'd it over /app/classes/com/guided/orci/web/auth/LoginController.class (md5 5c21ff7c... -> a197f9ee...). (2) Built the HEAD webapp with only ViewPatient.tsx and OperationTab.tsx reverted to the parent commit (bundle static/index.DAYfOJPN.js) and docker-cp'd its index.html + chunks over /app/resources/static. Restarted the container, readiness UP. Red: signed-in POST /api/login/check with no tenant returned 500 'No message available' and the log showed 'Request processing failed: java.lang.NullPointerException' with 'at com.guided.orci.types.wrappers.TenantKey.getOrg(TenantKey.java:62)' (3 occurrences); signed-out no-tenant returned 500 NotImplementedException and DID set a SESSION cookie. Same Playwright flow from Home: trail href=/admin/patients?client_id=null, Launch href ...&client_id=null, View Operation href ...debugger?client_id=null; the debugger showed 'Unable to load case' (count 1, meta null) and the log carried 'ERROR: relation "operations" does not exist' (3 occurrences). Following the null Launch href rendered 'Unable to launch GuidedOR for this case / Unable to authenticate user' with 500 /api/login/check, the stage failure from the ticket. Reverted: restored the backed-up class (md5 back to 5c21ff7c49913cf686714fb94a04b42f), restored the shipped index.html, deleted the pre-fix chunks, restarted, readiness UP, served bundle back to static/index.LCIyAXid.js; re-ran both probes and they matched the positive run exactly, with 0 signature lines in the log since restore.

caveats: Only the demo-demo tenant was exercised; the MGB user-mismatch branch of the login check (tenant.isKnownTenant() && tenant.isMgb()) was not run against the app, it is covered by the shipped LoginControllerTest unit test.
SSO itself cannot complete locally; the signed-out login check was observed only up to its response (SSO redirect for demo-demo, 400 for no tenant).

A hand-typed /app-launch?...&client_id=null on the fixed build no longer crashes the login check but still fails later with 500 /api/app-launch 'Unable to retrieve patient record'; that tenant-less launch is outside this ticket's claims.

useAppQueryParams memoises the tenant per component mount; every in-app route into the patient page and debugger remounts them, so no stale tenant was reachable through the UI, but a future same-route tenant switch without remount would read the old value.

automation.assessment: The fix shipped with its own coverage. orci/src/test/java/com/guided/orci/web/auth/LoginControllerTest.java has five plain unit tests: signed-in no tenant -> AlreadyLoggedIn, signed-in MGB user mismatch, signed-out no tenant -> 400 and no session, signed-in known tenant, signed-out demo -> SSO with the session tenant attribute. That is the whole backend change and it is named *Test so surefire runs it. qa-suite/smoke/patient-data.spec.ts PAT-006 (@core) walks the exact Home -> row menu -> Patients -> View path, asserts the trail, Launch and View Operation hrefs carry client_id, that the debugger loads the case without 'Unable to load case', and that the copied launch link carries client_id. The one affected call the ticket names that PAT-006 does not touch is the create-case call from the patient page (CreateOperationForm has its own useTenantId() instance, so a regression there would not move the links PAT-006 checks). Worth locking in as an extension of PAT-006; nothing else is uncovered.

proposed_tests.test: Extend PAT-006: after the link assertions, open Add Operation on the Home-entered patient page, pick a procedure type and submit; assert the POST /api/admin/patients/{uuid}/operations/create request carried X-Tenant-Id={TENANT_CLIENT_ID} and that a second case row appears whose Launch href carries client_id={TENANT_CLIENT_ID}. Control: a positive-value assertion (a null tenant header is rejected by the server, so no row appears); observed red with the pre-fix bundle during validation. Must not disturb SMOKE_CASE_ID (it adds a second case, the smoke case stays).

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: Entering from Home with no client_id, the admin patient page's trail, Launch and View Operation links, the debugger, the copied launch link and the create-case call all carried the demo-demo tenant, and the launch rendered the case.
Negative: No link, header or copied URL carried client_id=null, the debugger showed no load error, and the tenant-less login check answered 400 signed-out (no session opened) and needsLogin=false signed-in instead of a 500.
Red check: Swapping the pre-fix controller class and pre-fix bundle into the running container made every link carry client_id=null, the debugger fail on a missing operations relation, and the login check crash with the TenantKey.getOrg NullPointerException; both were restored and re-verified.

Automation: The shipped LoginControllerTest and PAT-006 cover the change; one extension to PAT-006 for the create-case call is proposed.
